label: Feature-uniform ontic demand: facts agreeing on feature k are alike required to have a reason why
definition: FeatureUniform S k says that for any two facts agreeing on the feature k, if the stance requires a reason why for one it requires one for the other. ShareFeature k t o says t and o agree on k. The norm is relative to a supplied k: it does not say which feature is the right ground of a demand, and a stance can be uniform in one feature and not in another.
